verdict.rationale: Thoropass offers built-in background automations (compliance monitors checking connected systems, automated evidence gathering for access reviews, reminders) and an MCP server letting an AI assistant act within the workspace, but there is no evidence users can configure or schedule autonomous AI-agent-driven background automations — the automation described is platform-native, not user-set-up agentic tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of user-configurable triggers/schedules for AI-driven automations, evidence of the MCP-connected assistant running unattended/autonomously rather than on-demand, and independent confirmation of such workflows.
